answer.reason: Verses 1KI 9:16 and 1KI 11:18 state deeds of this Pharaoh beyond the relations in the summary.

clauses.english: took Gezer, burned it with fire and slew the Canaanites there
clauses.quote: taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites

clauses.english: took in Hadad and gave him a house, food and land
clauses.quote: gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land

doubts: 1KI 9:9 is marked but speaks of the land of Egypt in general, not this Pharaoh, so it was left out.

The Pharaoh who received Hadad (1KI 11:18-22) lived in David's and Solomon's time and may be another Pharaoh than Solomon's father in law; I kept only the one clause about him, since the summary already links him to Hadad.
The listed event of Shishak attacking Jerusalem (1KI 14:25-26) concerns a different king of Egypt and was left out.
